findings.description: The requirement calls for detection at the moment elapsed time exceeds the limit, while its rationale calls for detection at the first 100 µs measurement step after the limit. CON-SUP-103 specifies 100 µs resolution but does not define how elapsed time or the detection instant is quantized. A verifier cannot determine the required detection time for a limit crossing between measurement steps.
findings.requested_change: Define a source-supported, measurable detection instant and the treatment of limit crossings between measurement steps; record a blocking open point if a product decision is needed.

findings.description: The requirement demands detection at the expiry instant while accepting a completion at that same instant. OP-SYS-009 acknowledges that the treatment of a completion in the same 100 µs measurement step as expiry is unspecified. A verifier cannot decide whether such a completion must cause fault code 3.
findings.requested_change: Classify OP-SYS-009 as blocking and obtain the decision needed to define the expiry-boundary behavior.
